description: WRITE: adds a tag to an account (mutates state). Tags label/segment accounts for review and automation. Sends JSON body { meta: { "tag-name": <tag_name> } }. Persona REST: POST /accounts/{account_id}/add-tag.

account_id.description: The account id to tag (e.g. act_...).

tag_name.description: The tag name to add to the account.

name: persona_add_account_tag
title: Add account tag
